cards.mood: The piece opens with a solemn and majestic atmosphere, establishing a sense of grandeur through slow-moving orchestral swells.
cards.palette: A full string section serves as the primary harmonic and melodic driver, present from the very beginning with sustained pads that evolve into rhythmic ostinatos during the build-up.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, mournful atmosphere that gradually expands into a sense of vast wonder and introspection.
cards.palette: A solo bowed string instrument (resembling an Erhu or Cello) carries the main melodic motif from the Intro through the first verse, establishing the melancholic tone.

cards.palette: A grand piano plays arpeggiated figures and chordal support from the Intro through the Outro, serving as the harmonic anchor.
